newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Aracruz still a neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Aracruz still a neutral.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said it was maintaining its neutral intermediate investment opinion for Brazilian pulp and paper firm Aracruz Celulose S.A..

-- "The company does not offer a compelling valuation in our view and we continue to believe pulp prices could face renewed weakness," Merill Lynch vice president Thomas Mello Souza wrote in a report.
-- He said Aracruz posted weaker-than-expected earnings in the second quarter.
-- "Aracruz reported earnings per ADR of $0.05 for the second quarter compared with $0.25 year-on-year, $0.11 quarter-on-quarter and our estimate of $0.11," he wrote.
-- Sales volumes were slightly higher than expected at 281,000 tons versus 279,000 tons with shipments off eight percent because of lower production, he said.
-- Net interest income plummeted to $1.0 million from $15.5 million in the second quarter of 1996.
-- Aracruz preferred A share closed at 2.10 reais Monday while its ADR ended at 20/04 in New York.
